parts.title: Passage 1
parts.article_title: Helping pupils to choose optional subjects when they're aged 14-15: what some pupils say

paragraphs.text: A Krishnan
paragraphs.translation: A 克里希南

paragraphs.text: I'm studying Spanish, because it's important to learn foreign languages - and I'm very pleased when l can watch a video in class and understand it.Mr Peckham really pushes us, and offers us extra assignments, to help us improve.That's good for me, because otherwise I’d be quite lazy.
paragraphs.translation:
我正在学习西班牙语，因为学习外语很重要——而且当我在课堂上能看懂视频内容时，我感到非常高兴。
佩卡姆老师对我们要求很严格，还会布置额外的作业来帮助我们提高。
这对我有好处，因为否则我会变得很懒惰。

paragraphs.text: B Lucy
paragraphs.translation: B 露西

paragraphs.text: History is my favourite subject, and it's fascinating to see how what we learn about the past is relevant to what's going on in the world now. It's made me understand much more about politics, for instance. My plan is to study history at university,and maybe go into the diplomatic service, so l can apply a knowledge of history.
paragraphs.translation:
历史是我最喜欢的科目，看到我们学到的关于过去的知识与当今世界发生的事情息息相关，这非常吸引人。
例如，这让我对政治有了更多的了解。
历史是我最喜欢的科目，看到我们学到的过去与当今世界发生的事情如何相关，这非常吸引人。
例如，这让我对政治有了更深入的理解。

paragraphs.text: C Mark
paragraphs.translation: C 马克

paragraphs.text: Thursdays are my favourite days, because that's when we have computing. It's the high spot of the week for me -l love learning how to program. I began when l was about eight, so when l started doing it at school, I didn't think I'd have any problem with it, but I was quite wrong! When l leave school, I'm going into my family retail business, so sadly I can't see myself becoming a programmer.
paragraphs.translation:
星期四是我最喜欢的日子，因为那是我们上计算机课的时候。
这对我来说是一周的高潮——我喜欢学习如何编程。
我大约八岁就开始学习编程，所以当我在学校开始做这件事时，我以为自己不会遇到任何问题，但我大错特错了！
当我离开学校后，我会进入家族的零售生意，所以遗憾的是，我无法想象自己会成为程序员。

paragraphs.text: D Violeta
paragraphs.translation: D 维奥莱塔

paragraphs.text: My parents both work in leisure and tourism, and they've always talked about their work a lot at home.l find it fascinating.I'm studying it at school, and the teacher is very knowledgeable, though l think we spend too much time listening to her; I'd like to meet more people working in the sector,and learn from their experience.
paragraphs.translation:
我的父母都在休闲与旅游行业工作，他们在家里总是经常谈论自己的工作。
我的父母都在休闲旅游行业工作，他们在家里经常谈论自己的工作。
我的父母都在休闲和旅游行业工作，他们在家里经常谈论自己的工作。

paragraphs.text: E Walid
paragraphs.translation: E 瓦利德

paragraphs.text: I've always been keen on art, so l chose it as an optional subject, though l was afraid the lessons might be a bit dull.l needn't have worried, though - our teacher gets us to do lots of fun things, so there's no risk of getting bored.At the end of the year the class puts on an exhibition for the school, and I'm looking forward to showing some of my work to other people.
paragraphs.translation:
我一直对艺术很感兴趣，所以选了它作为选修科目，尽管我担心课程可能会有点枯燥。
不过我其实不必担心——我们的老师带我们做了很多有趣的事，所以不会感到无聊。
学年末，班级会为学校举办一个展览，我很期待向其他人展示我的一些作品。
我一直对艺术很感兴趣，所以把它选为选修科目，尽管我担心课程可能会有点枯燥。
不过，我原本不必担心——我们的老师让我们做很多有趣的事情，所以不可能感到无聊。
年底，全班会为学校举办一次展览，我很期待向其他人展示我的一些作品。
我一直对艺术很感兴趣，所以我选了它作为选修科目，尽管我担心课程可能会有点无聊。
不过，我本不必担心——我们的老师让我们做很多有趣的事情，所以不会有感到无聊的风险。
年底班上会为学校举办一次展览，我期待着向其他人展示我的一些作品。

paragraphs.text: It's almost time for the next Ripton Festival!
paragraphs.translation: 下一届里普顿节即将到来！

paragraphs.text: A

As usual, the festival will be held in the last weekend of June, this year on Saturday to Monday, 27-29 June. Ever since last year's festival, the committee has been hard at work to make this year's the best ever! The theme is Ripton through the ages. Scenes will be acted out showing how the town has developed since it was first established. But there's also plenty that's up-to-date, from the latest music to local crafts.
paragraphs.translation:
像往常一样，这个节日将在6月的最后一个周末举行，今年是6月27日星期六至6月29日星期一。
自去年节日以来，委员会一直努力工作，力求使今年的节日成为有史以来最好的！
主题是“穿越时代的里普顿”。
将上演场景剧，展示这个城镇自最初建立以来是如何发展的。
但也有很多与时俱进的内容，从最新音乐到当地手工艺品，不一而足。

paragraphs.text: B

The Craft Fair is a regular part of the festival. Come and meet professional artists, designers and craftsmen and women, who will display their jewellery, paintings, ceramics, and much more. They'll also take orders, so if you want one of them to make something especially for you, just ask! You'll get it within a month of the festival ending.
paragraphs.translation:
工艺展是本次节日的常规活动之一。
前来与专业的艺术家、设计师以及男女工匠们会面吧，他们将展示各自的珠宝、绘画、陶瓷作品以及更多其他物品。
他们还会接受订单，因此，如果你希望其中一位为你专门制作某件物品，尽管提出要求！
你将在节日结束后的一个月内收到它。

paragraphs.text: C

The Saturday barbecue will start at 2 pm and continue until 10 pm, with a bouncy castle for kids. The barbecue will be held in Palmer's Field, or in the town hall if there's rain. Book your tickets now, as they always sell out very quickly! Entry for under 16s is free all day; adults can come for free until 6 pm and pay 5 after that. There’ll be live music throughout,with local amateur bands in the afternoon and professional musicians in the evening.
paragraphs.translation:
周六的烧烤活动将于下午2点开始，一直持续到晚上10点，现场还为孩子们设有充气城堡。
烧烤活动将在帕尔默场地举行，如果下雨则改到市政厅。
请立即预订门票，因为它们总是很快售罄！
16岁以下人士全天免费入场；成人下午6点前可免费入场，之后需支付5英镑。
全程将有现场音乐表演，下午是本地业余乐队，晚上则是专业音乐人。

paragraphs.text: D

On Sunday we're delighted to introduce an afternoon of boat races, arranged by the Ripton Rowing Club. The spectator area by the bridge has plenty of room to stand and cheer the boats home, in addition to a number of benches.The winners of the races will be presented with trophies by the mayor of Ripton.
paragraphs.translation:
周日，我们很高兴地推出由里普顿划船俱乐部组织的一下午的划船比赛。
桥边的观众区除了有大量长椅外，还有足够的站立空间，可以欢呼船只冲过终点。
比赛的获胜者将由里普顿市长颁发奖杯。

paragraphs.text: E
All money raised by the festival will go to support the sports clubs in Ripton.
paragraphs.translation: 该节日筹集的所有资金将用于支持里普顿的体育俱乐部。

groups.instructions:
Questions 1 - 6
Look at the five comments about lessons, A-E, on passage 1.
For which comments are the following statements true?
Write the correct letter, A, B, C or D, in boxes 32-37 on your answer sheet.
NB You may use any letter more than once.

questions.prompt: This pupil is interested in the subject despite the way it is taught.
questions.analysis: 题干描述“尽管教学方式如此，这位学生仍对该科目感兴趣”，对应Violeta（D）的陈述：“I find it fascinating... though I think we spend too much time listening to her”，她认为课程内容吸引人，但教学方式偏重听讲，希望有更多实践交流，符合“尽管教学方式不理想但仍感兴趣”的逻辑，故答案为D。
questions.reason: Violeta对课程感兴趣（fascinating），但认为老师讲太多（spend too much time listening）。
questions.location_analysis: Violeta觉得课程吸引人，但希望少听老师讲。
questions.paraphrasing: interested despite the way it is taught -> I find it fascinating ... though I think we spend too much time listening to her
questions.keywords: interested, despite the way it is taught
evidence: I'd like to meet more people working in the sector,and learn from their experience.

questions.prompt: This pupil is hoping to have a career that makes use of the subject.
questions.analysis: 题干要求找出“希望未来职业能运用所学科目”的学生，Lucy（B）明确表示“My plan is to study history at university, and maybe go into the diplomatic service, so I can apply a knowledge of history”，说明她计划将历史知识应用于外交工作，完全符合题意，故答案为B。
questions.reason: Lucy明确说未来要使用历史知识。
questions.location_analysis: Lucy计划学历史并从事外交，利用历史知识。
questions.paraphrasing: hoping to have a career that makes use of the subject -> My plan is to study history at university, and maybe go into the diplomatic service, so I can apply a knowledge of history
questions.keywords: career, make use of the subject
evidence: My plan is to study history at university,and maybe go into the diplomatic service, so l can apply a knowledge of history.

questions.prompt: This pupil finds the subject harder than they expected.
questions.analysis: 题干描述“发现科目比预期更难”，Mark（C）提到“I began when I was about eight, so when I started doing it at school, I didn't think I'd have any problem with it, but I was quite wrong!”，表明他原以为编程很简单，实际却出乎意料地困难，与题干完全对应，故答案为C。
questions.reason: 原文C段直接表明预期与现实的差距。
questions.location_analysis: Mark本以为编程没问题，但实际上很困难，出乎意料。
questions.paraphrasing: harder than expected -> didn't think I'd have any problem with it, but I was quite wrong
evidence: I began when l was about eight, so when l started doing it at school, I didn't think I'd have any problem with it, but I was quite wrong!

questions.prompt: This pupil finds the lessons very entertaining.
questions.analysis: 题干称“觉得课程非常有趣”，Walid（E）表示“our teacher gets us to do lots of fun things, so there's no risk of getting bored”，说明课堂活动丰富有趣，不会无聊，与“very entertaining”相符，故答案为E。
questions.reason: Walid指出课堂有趣，不会无聊。
questions.location_analysis: Walid觉得老师安排很多有趣活动，课不无聊。
questions.paraphrasing: finds the lessons very entertaining -> our teacher gets us to do lots of fun things, so there's no risk of getting bored
evidence: our teacher gets us to do lots of fun things, so there's no risk of getting bored.

questions.prompt: This pupil appreciates the benefit of doing challenging work.
questions.analysis: 题干描述“欣赏做有挑战性作业的好处”，Krishnan（A）提到“Mr Peckham really pushes us, and offers us extra assignments... That's good for me, because otherwise I’d be quite lazy”，说明他认可老师布置额外任务对自己提升的帮助，符合题意，故答案为A。
questions.reason: Krishnan认可额外作业对改进有益。
questions.location_analysis: Krishnan认为老师的严格要求有帮助，否则他会偷懒。
questions.paraphrasing: benefit of doing challenging work -> Mr Peckham really pushes us, and offers us extra assignments, to help us improve.That's good for me, because otherwise I’d be quite lazy.
evidence: Mr Peckham really pushes us, and offers us extra assignments, to help us improve.That's good for me, because otherwise I’d be quite lazy.

questions.prompt: This pupil has realised the connection between two things.
questions.analysis: 题干要求找出“意识到两件事之间联系”的学生，Lucy（B）说“it's fascinating to see how what we learn about the past is relevant to what's going on in the world now”，明确表达了历史学习与当今世界之间的关联，符合“realised the connection between two things”，故答案为B。
questions.reason: Lucy发现历史和当下的联系。
questions.location_analysis: Lucy意识到历史与当今世界的关联，故选B。
questions.paraphrasing: connection between two things -> it's fascinating to see how what we learn about the past is relevant to what's going on in the world now.
evidence: it's fascinating to see how what we learn about the past is relevant to what's going on in the world now.

groups.instructions:
Questions 7 - 14
Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage 2?
Choose TRUE if the statement agrees with the information given in the text, choose FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or choose NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

questions.prompt: The festival is held every year.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“held every year”对应原文段落A开头的“As usual, the festival will be held...”，其中“As usual”表明该节日是每年常规举行的活动，因此该陈述与原文信息一致，答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: As usual表明活动常规每年举行。
questions.location_analysis: 原文说'As usual'暗示每年举办，故TRUE。
questions.paraphrasing: held every year -> As usual, the festival will be held
evidence: As usual, the festival will be held in the last weekend of June, this year on Saturday to Monday, 27-29 June.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 选项与原文信息矛盾，原文明确表示每年举行。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 选项声称信息未提及，但原文明确给出了每年举行的信息。

questions.prompt: This year's festival focuses on the town's history.
questions.analysis: 题干中提到“focuses on the town's history”，而原文段落A明确指出“The theme is Ripton through the ages”，即节日主题是展现Ripton镇从古至今的发展历程，这与“关注城镇历史”完全对应，因此答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: 主题直接说明关注历史。
questions.location_analysis: 主题贯穿年代，关注历史，与题干一致，TRUE。
questions.paraphrasing: focuses on the town's history -> The theme is Ripton through the ages.
evidence: The theme is Ripton through the ages.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文明确提到今年的节日聚焦于小镇历史，该选项与原文信息矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确给出了节日聚焦小镇历史的信息，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: Goods displayed in the craft fair are unlike ones found in shops.
questions.analysis: 题干称手工艺集市上的商品“不同于商店里的商品”，但原文段落B仅说明集市上会展示珠宝、绘画、陶瓷等手工艺品，并可接受定制订单，未提及这些商品是否与商店所售不同，因此文中无相关信息，答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.reason: 文章只说展示工艺品，未说明是否与商店不同。
questions.location_analysis: 原文未提及与商店商品的比较。
questions.keywords: Goods displayed are unlike ones found in shops

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文未提及手工艺博览会的商品与商店商品是否不同，因此无法支持该说法。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文未提及两者是否不同，不能断定它们并非不同。

questions.prompt: The barbecue will be cancelled if it rains.
questions.analysis: 题干说“如果下雨，烧烤会被取消”，但原文段落C明确指出“The barbecue will be held in Palmer's Field, or in the town hall if there's rain”，说明下雨时活动将移至市政厅举行，并非取消，因此该陈述与原文矛盾，答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: 下雨时有室内替代地点，非取消。
questions.location_analysis: 下雨时移至市政厅，并非取消，故FALSE。
questions.paraphrasing: cancelled if it rains -> or in the town hall if there's rain
evidence: The barbecue will be held in Palmer's Field, or in the town hall if there's rain.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 与原文信息矛盾，原文暗示烧烤不会因下雨取消。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文已明确给出相关信息，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: Adults can attend the barbecue at any time without charge.
questions.analysis: 题干声称“成人可随时免费参加烧烤”，但原文段落C说明“adults can come for free until 6 pm and pay £5 after that”，即成人仅在下午6点前免费，之后需付费，因此该陈述与原文不符，答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: 免费限时，并非任意时间。
questions.location_analysis: 成人6点前免费，之后付费，并非随时免费，故FALSE。
questions.paraphrasing: at any time without charge -> adults can come for free until 6 pm and pay 5 after that
evidence: adults can come for free until 6 pm and pay 5 after that.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文明确指出成年人参加烧烤需要付费，与题干'without charge'矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确提及成年人参加烧烤需要付费，该信息在原文中已给出，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: Amateur musicians will perform during the whole of the barbecue.
questions.analysis: 题干称“业余音乐人将在整个烧烤期间表演”，但原文段落C提到“There’ll be live music throughout, with local amateur bands in the afternoon and professional musicians in the evening”，说明业余乐队只在下午演出，晚上由专业音乐人表演，因此该陈述错误，答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: 晚上是专业音乐人，不是全程业余。
questions.location_analysis: 下午业余乐队，晚上专业音乐人。
questions.paraphrasing: during the whole of the barbecue -> There’ll be live music throughout,with local amateur bands in the afternoon and professional musicians in the evening.
evidence: There’ll be live music throughout,with local amateur bands in the afternoon and professional musicians in the evening.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文明确指出业余音乐家只在烧烤的部分时间表演，与题干‘整个烧烤期间’矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文提供了业余音乐家表演时间的具体信息，因此并非未提及。

questions.prompt: Seating is available for watching the boat races.
questions.analysis: 题干询问观看划船比赛是否有座位，原文段落D明确提到“The spectator area... in addition to a number of benches”，其中“benches”即指供观众使用的座位，因此该陈述与原文一致，答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: 明确提及有benches。
questions.location_analysis: 原文提到有长凳提供座位，故TRUE。
questions.paraphrasing: Seating is available -> in addition to a number of benches
evidence: The spectator area by the bridge has plenty of room to stand and cheer the boats home, in addition to a number of benches.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文明确提到有座位提供，与选项内容矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文直接给出了相关信息，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: People attending the festival will be asked to donate some money.
questions.analysis: 题干称“参加者会被要求捐款”，但原文段落E仅说明“All money raised by the festival will go to support the sports clubs”，并未说明资金来源是否包括现场募捐或强制捐款，也未提及是否向参与者提出捐赠请求，因此信息未给出，答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.reason: 未说明是否要求参加者捐款。
questions.location_analysis: 原文仅提及资金支持体育俱乐部，未说明来源是否为捐赠，故NOT GIVEN。
evidence: All money raised by the festival will go to support the sports clubs in Ripton.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文未提及参与者是否被要求捐款。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文未提及参与者被要求捐款的相关信息，无法确定该陈述为假。

paragraphs.text: A

Farms tend to be full of activity. There are always jobs to be done and some tasks require physical manual work. While it is good for people to be active, there are risk factors associated with this, and efforts need to be made to reduce them.
paragraphs.translation:
农场通常充满了各种活动。
总有工作需要完成，其中一些任务需要体力劳动。
虽然人们保持活跃是有益的，但这伴随着一些风险因素，因此需要努力减少这些风险。

paragraphs.text: B

The first risk relates to the carrying of an excessive load or weight.This places undue demands on the spine and can cause permanent damage. Examples of tasks that involve this risk are moving 50-kilogramme fertiliser bags from one site to another or carrying heavy buckets of animal feed around fields.According to the UK Health and Safety Executive, activities such as these 'should be avoided at all times'. Their documentation states that other methods should be considered, such as breaking down the load into smaller containers prior to movement or transporting the materials using a tractor or other vehicle.The risk posed by excessive force is made worse if the person lifting is also bending over as this increases pressure on the discs in the back.
paragraphs.translation:
第一个风险与搬运过重的负荷或重量有关。
这会给脊柱带来不必要的压力，并可能导致永久性损伤。
涉及此类风险的工作示例包括将50公斤重的化肥袋从一个地点搬运到另一个地点，或在田间搬运沉重的动物饲料桶。

paragraphs.text: C

If a load is bulky or hard to grasp, such as a lively or agitated animal, it will be more difficult to hold while lifting and carrying.The holder may adopt an awkward posture,which is tiring and increases the risk of injury. Sometimes a load has to be held away from the body because there is a large obstacle in the area and the person lifting needs to be able to see where their feet are going. This results in increased stress on the back;holding a load at arm's length imposes about five times the stress of a close-to-the-body position. In such cases, handling aids should be purchased that can take the weight off the load and minimise the potential for injury.

Another risk that relates to awkward posture is repetitive bending when carrying out a task.An example might be repairing a gate that has collapsed onto the ground.This type of activity increases the stress on the lower back because the back muscles have to support the weight of the upper body. The farmer should think about whether the job can be performed on a workbench, reducing the need for prolonged awkward posture.

paragraphs.text: Good customer service in retail
paragraphs.translation: 零售业中的优质客户服务

paragraphs.text: A
Without customers, your retail business would not exist. It stands to reason, therefore, that how you treat your customers has a direct impact on your profit margins.
paragraphs.translation:
没有顾客，您的零售业务将无法存在。
因此，理所当然地，您对待顾客的方式会直接影响您的利润空间。

paragraphs.text: B

Some customers just want to browse and not be bothered by sales staff.Try to be sensitive to how much help a customer wants; be proactive in offering help without being annoying. Suggest a product that naturally accompanies what the customer is considering or point out products for which there are special offers, but don’t pressure a customer into buying an item they don't want.
paragraphs.translation:
有些顾客只想随意浏览，不愿被销售人员打扰。
要敏锐地察觉顾客需要多少帮助；主动提供协助，但不要令人厌烦。
推荐与顾客正在考虑的商品自然搭配的产品，或者指出有特价优惠的商品，但不要强迫顾客购买他们不想要的东西。

paragraphs.text: C

Build up a comprehensive knowledge of all the products in your shop, including the pros and cons of products that are alike but that have been produced under a range of brand names. If you have run out of a particular item, make sure you know when the next orders are coming in. Negativity can put customers off instantly. If a customer asks a question to which the answer is 'no', do not just leave it at that - follow it with a positive, for example:'we're expecting more of that product in on Tuesday ‘.
paragraphs.translation:
全面了解你商店中的所有产品，包括那些相似但由不同品牌生产的产品各自的优缺点。
如果某种商品已经售罄，请确保你知道下一批订单何时到货。
消极的态度会立刻让顾客感到反感。
如果顾客提出了一个答案为“没有”的问题，不要仅仅就此打住——随后给出积极的回应，例如：“我们预计周二会到更多那种产品。”

paragraphs.text: D

Meanwhile, if you see a product in the wrong place on a shelf, don’t ignore it - put it back where it belongs. This attention to presentation keeps the shop tidy, giving the right impression to your customers. Likewise, if you notice a fault with a product, remove it and replace it with another.
paragraphs.translation:
同时，如果你看到货架上的商品放错了位置，不要忽视它——把它放回原处。
这种对陈列的关注能保持店铺整洁，给顾客留下良好的印象。
同样地，如果你注意到某件商品有瑕疵，应将其移除并替换另一件。

paragraphs.text: E

When necessary, be discreet.For example, if the customer's credit card is declined at the till,keep your voice down and enquire about an alternative payment method quietly so that the customer doesn't feel humiliated.If they experience uncomfortable emotions in your shop,it's unlikely that they'll come back.
paragraphs.translation:

paragraphs.text: F

Finally, good manners are probably the most important aspect of dealing with customers.Treat each person with respect at all times, even when you are faced with rudeness.Being discourteous yourself will only add more fuel to the fire.

Build a reputation for polite, helpful staff and you'll find that customers not only keep giving you their custom, but also tell their friends about you.

In 2017, Carlos Ferrando, a Spanish engineer-turned-entrepreneur, saw a piece of art in a museum that profoundly affected him. "What Lies Under', a photographic composition by Indonesian digital artist Ferdi Rizkiyanto, shows a child crouching by the edge of the ocean and 'lifting up' a wave, to reveal a cluster of assorted plastic waste, from polyethylene bags to water bottles. The artwork, designed to raise public awareness, left Ferrando angry - and fuelled with entrepreneurial ideas.

sentence_translations.sentence: Hence the fact that water became a consumer item, sold in plastic bottles, instead of just emerging, for free, from a tap.
